units: X southeast along street, Y inward (west face=0), Z up from street grade; metres. Coordinates derive from photographs, without a building survey.
method: Local east/north tangent coordinates from the two southernmost ground-floor lintel centres; X follows the long footprint edge to the southeast. Eight independent station poses use photographed masonry lines, the pair of southern heads, ten northern window bearings, and independent door, cornice and window control points. Pixel errors are per observation after fitting. A porch or sash can sit away from Y=0. The real lower edges behind shrubs and the roof behind the parapet remain estimates.
